125NoteAcross four startup traces, common slow heating is compatible with boundary resistance ×1.2. Alternative power ×1.14 plus capacity ×1.2 fits too, but needs two global faults and is not clearly distinguished given transient fidelity. Boundary-only predicts core2 high plateau 97.86 vs 99–100; a normal +3% slope contributes 1.68 C, so this does not establish a sensor fault. Other sensors and package fit within ambient/slope/fidelity allowances. Prefer single global boundary conductance overestimate pending final local-power validation.
